description: Compare an architecture model (inline dsl, a documentId, or else architecture.ofk in path) against a repository. Returns missing (in repo, not in model), undrawn (in model, no repo evidence) and changed (name matches, tech or dir differs) with evidence lines.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open; without dsl or documentId, the model is architecture.ofk in path.

dsl.description: Inline OFK architecture workspace; wins over documentId.

path.description: Absolute or cwd-relative path to the repository root.

name: drift_report
title: Architecture drift report
